acceptanceCriteria.text: Active managed generation is retained by an explicit durable GC-root/profile mechanism owned by the managed Runtime lifecycle.
Previous and candidate generations required for rollback/recovery are retained for exactly the documented lifecycle window.
Activation/replacement updates retention transactionally so interruption cannot silently collect the only recoverable generation.
Health rejects a missing/dangling active generation target.
Health verifies the required active Mottainai CLI/MCP executable paths exist in the realized generation before reporting `managedRuntimeReady=true`.
No-op reconciliation preserves the same active generation identity and retention roots.
Update/rollback/recovery tests cover GC between lifecycle transitions and prove the active/recoverable generations remain usable.
A focused regression test proves a dangling persisted pointer cannot satisfy readiness.
Existing fail-closed and rollback semantics remain intact.

issue.title: fix(runtime): retain managed generations as durable GC roots and reject dangling readiness
